text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the heck!
I've got a sunburn line right under my headband...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No waaay!
It's 'cause I forgot to put on sunscreen!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You don't gotta make even that unfunny!
Waaahh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...I should put some aloe on this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross was unexpectedly conscious about the condition of her skin...
